name: Keith D. Maples
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Austin, Texas
education: South Texas College of Law Houston
about: Keith D. Maples is an attorney providing legal services covering Family Law and Alternative Dispute Resolution.

Keith Maples, who practices law in Austin, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2012 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at South Texas College of Law Houston. He graduated in 1991. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1991.
honors: State Bar of Texas - Family Law Section- Checklist Committee- 1998-1999
Travis County Family Law Advocates - Treasurer - 2003-2011
Travis County Bar Association - Family Law Section - Director from 1998-2002; Treasurer 1999-2000; Vice- Chairman 2000-01; and Chairman 2001-02

Being a member of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers means: The attorney has demonstrated an active interest and competency in matrimonial law as evidenced by the fulfillment of criteria and standards as established by the AAML Board of Examiners and Board of Governors. The attorney has substantial experience and is able to handle complex matters relating to custody and support of children, property division and alimony or spousal support. The attorney is recognized by the bench and bar as a leading practitioner in the area of matrimonial law. The attorney has demonstrated substantial involvement in the matrimonial field and has endeavored to encourage the study, improve the practice, elevate the standards and advance the cause of matrimonial law , Fellow , American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers , 2013
